title: App asks who I am before showing anything
observation: First screen after the splash: "PATINA" / "Welcome home" / "Start with a piece you love" over "Sign in with Apple", "Continue with Google", "Continue with email", "or", "Look around first →", "Have a password? Sign in". No piece, no room, no story is shown before the ask.
why_it_matters: The first-open moment spends its only motivation on an account instead of on the thing that would make me want a second open.
already_ruled: C9 (passwordless-first + soft wall; guests browse)
proposal_seed: Let the first screen be one real piece or the room prompt, with sign-in as the second beat.

title: Tour never teaches the save loop it promises
observation: The shipped tour runs two steps: "Step 1 of 2 / Welcome to Patina" — "This is your Daily Room — picks and stories chosen for your space." and "Step 2 of 2 / Your profile" — "Rooms, saved pieces, and settings live here." The declared middle step "Save what you love" / "Add pieces to a room with + Add — they follow you everywhere." never renders; its anchor `.addToRoom` mounts in no view.
why_it_matters: The one mechanic that would give a first-day user something of their own to come back to is the one the first run never explains.
already_ruled: C18 (tour copy is canonical and delivered)
july_status: residual — U32 DELIVERED-VERIFIED as copy; the middle step's anchor died with the orphaned DailyProductCard
proposal_seed: Re-anchor step 2 on whatever control actually saves a piece today, or cut the step and say two.

title: Quiz payoff ends without a door to the pieces
observation: After five questions the result screen reads "YOUR STYLE, FOUND" / "Warm Modern" / "A STARTING POINT — REFINE IT ANY TIME.", and scrolled to the end it terminates on "Tune the portrait / Tell Patina which direction feels closer. / Tune this" — no "see your recommendations" act.
why_it_matters: The single biggest day-1 investment closes on a dead end, so the effort never converts into a habit of looking at pieces.
july_status: possible regression of U38 (quiz CTA now routes to .emergence) — what would settle this: a fresh capture of StyleResultView's full scroll with scan_ui, listing every button on the screen
proposal_seed: Put "Browse pieces" as the result screen's primary act, above "Tune this".

title: Guest's day-one work is gone on day two
observation: After a force-quit the guest lands back on "Welcome home" / "Start with a piece you love" with the quiz, the portrait and the session discarded — while the Companion on that same launch still lists "Style quiz / DISCOVER YOUR STYLE" and "Your recommendations / TAKE THE QUIZ FIRST" and Profile still shows the "Warm Modern" badge.
why_it_matters: Day-2 return is the whole game, and the app greets its most invested new user by forgetting them and saying "Welcome home".
already_ruled: C9 (guests browse; soft wall)
proposal_seed: Persist guest opt-in across launches so the second open resumes the first.

title: The first ask is the app's heaviest act
observation: The only act on the first home is "NEXT MOVE / Bring your first room into Patina / A short scan gives the Companion a real space to work from." — which, without LiDAR, lands on a typed form headed "TELL US ABOUT YOUR SPACE / What kind of room?".
why_it_matters: Fogg's ability axis is lowest on day one, and the app spends that moment on a whole-room capture instead of a five-second act that could bring me back tomorrow.
already_ruled: C3 (room scan stays prominent); C23 (Today = exactly one next move)
proposal_seed: Offer a one-tap alternative next move — save one piece — beside the room ask.

title: Only the date line changes between two mornings
observation: The signed-in home holds four things — "WEDNESDAY · AUG 26" / "Today", "NEXT MOVE / Review a project decision / 2 decisions need your eye.", "MAKER SPOTLIGHT / The Grain Whisperer of Maine", "ACTIVE ROOM / Living Room" — and the relaunch shot is pixel-identical to the first.
why_it_matters: A daily-return product must have something new on the first screen; today the only guaranteed daily delta is the date string.
already_ruled: C23 (Option B Today contract: one next move, one story, one active room)
proposal_seed: Give Today one module whose content is produced by someone other than me since my last visit.

title: Same story forever, permanently marked unread
observation: Every lane, every tier and every relaunch shows the same card: "4 MIN READ" with a clay dot in the corner, "MAKER SPOTLIGHT / The Grain Whisperer of Maine / Jonathan Chilton on 40 years of listening to wood".
why_it_matters: The one editorial surface that could be an honest variable reward never rotates, and its freshness marker is hard-coded true — a fabricated "new".
already_ruled: C5 (no fabricated signals); C28 names the hard-coded dot
proposal_seed: Derive the dot from a stored last-read story id and stop serving one row forever.

title: "Today" reads the same at 7:40am and 9pm
observation: The header is "WEDNESDAY · AUG 26" over the literal word "Today" with a "?" glyph — no greeting, no part-of-day, at any hour.
why_it_matters: The product's thesis is a daily ritual, but the home cannot tell morning coffee from evening couch, so the same card has to serve both moods.
proposal_seed: Read the TimeOfDay token the design system already ships and let the header name the hour.

title: Today hides the four things awaiting the client
observation: The signed-in home shows one line about work — "2 decisions need your eye." — while two levels down the Studio reads "4 things need your eye" with "Decisions / 2 project choices are ready / Overdue · Aug 22", "Invoice / $4,250.00 remaining / Due Sep 1" and "Proposal / Aspen Loft — Living Room Refresh / Review by Sep 8".
why_it_matters: The only reasons this user has to open the app tomorrow — an overdue decision, an unpaid invoice, an expiring proposal — are absent from the screen they land on.
already_ruled: C23 (Today = exactly one next move) — the conflict with C2's tier-morphing home is open
proposal_seed: Let Today's one next move carry the whole awaiting-you count and its dates.

title: Home has no Browse, Saved, Studio or designer door
observation: `describe_screen` on the signed-in home returns four content elements — Next Move, editorial story, "ACTIVE ROOM", Companion bubble — and swiping up changes nothing; there is no tab bar, no nav bar, no "Browse pieces", no "Saved", no "Get design help" and no Studio row anywhere on the screen.
why_it_matters: Every place my accumulated investment lives is now reachable only through an unlabeled orb or an unlabeled monogram, which is a tax on every single return.
already_ruled: C23 (Option B accepted; the July rail is orphaned, not ruled over — C2 vs C23 is an open ruling for Kody)
july_status: regression — U24 (MarketplaceLinksSection persists at every tier), U23 ("All rooms →" chip on home) and U44 (home footer links) were DELIVERED-VERIFIED and are unmounted at 3cd84ecb3
proposal_seed: Re-mount one persistent doors row under Today's three modules, inside the Option B contract.

title: A project with nothing pending disappears from Today
observation: Next Move is a strictly ordered ladder; with decisions and unread messages at zero it falls back to "Return to {Room}" / "{n} pieces are gathering there." — the live project is named nowhere on the home.
why_it_matters: Between milestones — which is most days of a real job — the app gives an active client no evidence their project exists.
proposal_seed: When a project is live, make the quiet-state Next Move the project's own progress, not the room.

title: Engaged home is the guest home, verbatim
observation: Signed in as James Okafor, whose lead was accepted and claimed by a designer on Aug 18, the home reads "NEXT MOVE / Bring your first room into Patina / A short scan gives the Companion a real space to work from." with the same story card and the footer "NEXT STEPS" — and the Companion panel has no "Your studio" row at all.
why_it_matters: The most powerful honest return trigger the product owns — a real designer took your request — is invisible to the exact user it happened to.
proposal_seed: Make the accepted lead the engaged tier's Next Move, naming the studio and the date.

title: Saved has no door until something is already saved
observation: With zero saved items the Companion panel lists "Add your first space", "Retake the quiz", "Your recommendations", "Your studio", "Your profile" — no "Saved" row, confirmed by scan_ui before and after adding a room; the row only appears once a count is non-zero ("Saved / 1 SAVED PIECE").
why_it_matters: The surface that is supposed to hold my investment is unreachable exactly when I am deciding whether this app is worth returning to, and the count that unlocks it ignores saves made from Browse or piece detail.
already_ruled: C1 (Companion is the nav)
july_status: regression — U09/U24 gave Saved a permanent home on the marketplace links block, now unmounted
proposal_seed: Show the Saved row always, with an honest empty subtitle, and count every save.

title: Saved opens on boards that can never hold a piece
observation: "Saved" opens on the "Boards" tab reading "No boards yet" / "Save pieces from recommendations to create your first board" / "Create Board" — while "All items" behind it holds the saved piece; `CollectionsViewModel.addToBoard(_:productId:)` has no call site, so a created board stays "This board is empty" forever.
why_it_matters: The first thing a returning saver sees is an empty room with an invitation to a loop the app cannot complete.
proposal_seed: Default to "All items" until a board can actually receive a piece.

title: A saved piece forgets it was saved
observation: The piece-detail primary button reads "Add to Room" and flips to "Saved ✓" only for the life of the screen: `toggleSave` inserts a local `TableItemModel` with no remote mirror, `isSaved` is never seeded from storage, and re-saving inserts a second row.
why_it_matters: An app that cannot show me what I already chose cannot use my own choices as the reason to come back.
july_status: residual — DELIVERY.md names "Add-to-Room gives no visible feedback and no confirmed saved_items row" as an open follow-up
proposal_seed: Seed `isSaved` from storage on appear and mirror every save to `saved_items`.

title: Home says zero pieces saved while Saved holds one
observation: The home card reads "ACTIVE ROOM / Living Room / 2713 sq ft · 0 pieces saved" on the same device and session where "Saved / All items" lists "ROOM & BOARD / Heirloom Oak Dining Table / $4200".
why_it_matters: The one module on Today that could show accumulation — "your room is one piece closer" — reports zero, so investment never becomes visible progress.
proposal_seed: Count unscoped saves toward the active room until a real room attachment exists.

title: My investment belongs to the phone, not the account
observation: "Your Spaces" tags the room "SAVED ON THIS PHONE" and "2713 SQ FT · MANUAL ENTRY" while Profile, the Companion and Today all count it as account data ("1 ROOMS", "1 SAVED PIECE"); after the local store was cleared the same account showed "0 ROOMS / 0 SAVED / — MATCH".
why_it_matters: Everything the app remembers about me can vanish with a reinstall or a new phone, which makes the accumulated-value story that drives long-run return untrue.
proposal_seed: Mirror rooms and saves to the account on sign-in and claim the guest store explicitly.

title: Nothing in the app answers "where is it"
observation: The Studio's sections are "Awaiting you", "In progress", "Conversation", "Money & documents", "Archive"; there is no order, no shipment, no ETA anywhere, and the client-facing order table `direct_orders` carries only `pending_payment / paid / canceled` (+ `refunded`).
why_it_matters: The post-purchase question is the most reliable daily-return habit a furnishings app can own, and it currently has no object to attach to.
already_ruled: C11 (direct orders are a ratified backlog item); C24 (backend exists, no iOS client, no designer attribution)
proposal_seed: Surface the BOH `fulfillment_orders` states the client already owns as a tracked item in Studio.

title: Project screen shows three stats and no timeline
observation: "PROJECT / Aspen Loft Refresh / Currently: Installation & Styling" then "BUDGET $120,000", "STATUS In Progress", "CLIENT VIEW Milestone", an "Invoices / View and pay your invoices" row and a link — no phases, no dates, no rooms, no selections, though the screen successfully fetched `project_phases` and `get_client_project_selections`.
why_it_matters: "Has anything moved?" is the question that brings a mid-procurement client back, and the screen that should answer it renders none of the data it already has.
proposal_seed: Render the fetched phases as a dated timeline with the current phase marked.

title: Client's project screen tells them to open the portal
observation: Below the stats sits a boxed line reading "Set up phases, payments, and FF&E in the portal →", and a stat labelled "CLIENT VIEW / Milestone" — both written for the designer, rendered to the homeowner.
why_it_matters: The screen a client returns to for reassurance instead exposes the machinery and points them at a place they cannot go.
already_ruled: C5 (honesty; no dead controls)
proposal_seed: Replace the portal line with a client-voiced empty state and hide the visibility-tier stat.

title: The whole Studio hides behind a 36pt monogram
observation: The only route to projects, proposals, invoices, budget and decisions is the unlabelled circular "C" in the top-right corner of the home, then a scroll past the avatar and stats to "STUDIO / The work around your home, in one place."
why_it_matters: Every reason an activeProject client has to open the app is three acts and one unlabelled corner glyph away, which is the opposite of a habit loop.
already_ruled: C1 (no tab bar; Companion + hub rail are the nav)
proposal_seed: Give the Studio its own labelled door on Today whenever the awaiting-you count is non-zero.

title: Three different counts for one inbox
observation: One screen prints "4 things need your eye" as its subhead and "4 THINGS NEED YOUR EYE" in the footer directly above a block headed "Awaiting you 3", while the home and the Companion both say "2 PROJECT DECISIONS WAITING".
why_it_matters: A count is a return trigger only while it is trustworthy; three answers to "how much is waiting" teaches me to ignore all of them.
proposal_seed: Compute one attention count in one place and render it everywhere.

title: No money or decision event can send a push
observation: Notifications reads "Nothing yet" / "Updates from your designer will land here." while the Studio shows an overdue decision, a $4,250.00 invoice due Sep 1 and a proposal to review by Sep 8; `apns-send` has five callers and not one touches invoices, proposals, decisions or orders.
why_it_matters: The app has no way to reach a client between opens for the only events they actually care about, so return depends entirely on them remembering.
already_ruled: C26 corrects C14 — push send is real and provisioned; nothing money-shaped calls it
proposal_seed: Add one `invoke_edge_function('apns-send', …)` to the proposal-sent, invoice-due and decision-asked triggers.

title: The bell is empty while four items are overdue
observation: "Notifications" / "Nothing yet" / "Updates from your designer will land here." — zero rows for an account with two decisions overdue since Aug 22, an invoice due Sep 1 and a proposal expiring Sep 8; the same screen in dark mode is identical.
why_it_matters: A returning client checks the bell first, learns it is always empty, and stops checking — killing the one in-app trigger that already exists.
proposal_seed: Write a `notification_log` row for every client-facing money and decision event, push or not.

title: Permission asked once, only after a design request
observation: Authorization is requested exactly once per install, from the first successful design-request submission, with no pre-permission screen and no rationale copy anywhere; the Settings row "Notifications" is a profile preference, not the OS grant, and was toggled on for a guest who can receive none.
why_it_matters: The permission that makes every future return trigger possible is spent at the moment of least demonstrated value, and a client who never files a request is never asked at all.
already_ruled: C28 names the single-prompt behaviour
proposal_seed: Ask at the first real event — a proposal or invoice arriving — with one plain sentence naming what will be sent.

title: Empty bell sells a designer to an existing client
observation: Below "Nothing yet" / "Updates from your designer will land here." the only act is a "Get design help" button, shown to a client with three projects, four proposals and a named designer, Leah Hartwell.
why_it_matters: A return surface that misreads who is standing in front of it teaches the client that the app does not know them.
already_ruled: C17 (tier-narration copy is canonical) — the copy is ruled, the tier selection is not
proposal_seed: Swap the CTA for "Message Leah" once a designer relationship exists.

title: Deadlines are printed once and never reminded
observation: The invoices list shows "INV-2026-0142 / $4,250.00 / Due Sep 1, 2026"; the invoice detail I act on drops the due date entirely, and the app contains no `UNNotificationRequest` of any kind, so it cannot remind me itself.
why_it_matters: A dated obligation is the most honest return trigger a client app can have, and this one exists only on a card the user has already left.
proposal_seed: Print the due date on the detail and offer one local reminder the user opts into.

title: Nothing anywhere computes "since your last visit"
observation: A relaunch after absence lands on a byte-identical "Today" — no welcome-back line, no unread marker, no last-visit timestamp, no activity feed; `ContextMemoryStore` records only a coarse activity kind and is off until the user turns it on.
why_it_matters: Two weeks away and one hour away produce the same screen, so the app can never pay off the absence it is asking me to end.
proposal_seed: Store a last-seen timestamp per surface and let Today say what changed after it.

title: Two silent fourteen-day decays punish absence
observation: A terminal or matched design request stops being promoted 14 days after its stage anchor, and the Companion mark graduates to its calm "learned" state at 14 days — neither is explained on any screen.
why_it_matters: The returning user's most likely first screen is quieter than the one they left, and nothing tells them why.
already_ruled: C8 (coaching phases and label decay are ruled)
proposal_seed: Keep a matched designer visible until the relationship actually ends, not on a timer.

title: Returning client is offered to re-file their request
observation: The sheet titled "Your design request" reads "No scans on this phone yet" / "You can scan a room to attach — or request design help without one below." with the single act "Request without a scan" — for an account whose request was already accepted and claimed.
why_it_matters: A returning engaged client is shown the beginning of a journey they already finished, which reads as the app losing their file.
proposal_seed: Route an existing non-terminal request to its status screen instead of the compose sheet.

title: Sharing a piece hands over the designer portal
observation: The iOS share sheet from a product card shows "Patina Designer Portal" / "app.patina.cloud" as the thing being shared.
why_it_matters: The household is the retention unit, and the one act that could recruit a second person hands them a door marked for somebody else's job.
proposal_seed: Share a homeowner-facing piece URL with the piece's own title and image.

title: The shared link cannot open the app
observation: The app declares only the custom scheme `patina` in Info.plist and carries no `com.apple.developer.associated-domains` entitlement, so the `https://app.patina.cloud/library/<id>` link it hands out opens Safari even for someone with Patina installed.
why_it_matters: Every off-app trigger — a share, an email, a future push landing page — dead-ends in a browser instead of returning someone to the app.
proposal_seed: Add associated domains so every Patina link opens the app when it is installed.

title: Only one piece can be shared with anyone
observation: The card menu offers "Save", "Share", "Not for me", "View details" — and there is no share on a room, a board, or the Saved list anywhere in the app.
why_it_matters: Couples decide on rooms, not on single chairs, so the app cannot participate in the conversation that actually precedes a purchase.
proposal_seed: Make a room shareable as a read-only page before making anything else shareable.

title: No partner, household, or second seat exists
observation: Settings' ACCOUNT section holds only "Account" (inert) and "Sign in on the web"; there is no invite, household, partner or co-viewer concept in the app, and no household or family-member table in 487 migrations.
why_it_matters: The second adult in the house has no way in, so half the decision-makers on a $4,000 piece never become returning users.
proposal_seed: Scope a single "invite your partner to this project" seat before any broader sharing model.

title: The app owns no surface outside itself
observation: The Xcode project declares three targets — app, unit tests, UI tests — and no app extension of any kind: no WidgetKit, no ActivityKit, no AppIntent, no NSUserActivity, no local notification, no background refresh.
why_it_matters: Every return has to start inside the user's own memory, because the app has no quiet place on the Home Screen, Lock Screen or in Spotlight to remind them it exists.
already_ruled: C28 (no widget/App Intent/Live Activity/associated-domains)
proposal_seed: Ship one small Home Screen widget showing the active room and the awaiting-you count.

title: Return has no instrumentation beyond app_open
observation: The app captures `app_open`, `session_started`, `today_next_move_tapped`, `today_editorial_story_tapped`, `today_active_room_tapped` and `studio_queue_item_activated`, but no push-received, push-opened, notification-permission-outcome or "new since last visit" event exists.
why_it_matters: No decision about return mechanics can be settled with evidence until the trigger-to-open path is measurable.
proposal_seed: Emit push_received / push_opened / permission_result before shipping any new trigger.

title: The editorial well holds three stories
observation: "MAKER SPOTLIGHT / The Grain Whisperer of Maine" is served by an unfiltered query for the single highest `sort_order` row, and the whole `editorial_stories` table holds exactly the three rows seeded by its own migration.
why_it_matters: The one module that could honestly be new every morning has no supply behind it, so an editorial answer to daily return is a content commitment, not a code change.
already_ruled: C3 (editorial feel of the Daily Room)
proposal_seed: Decide the publishing cadence and the writer before Today leans any harder on the story.

title: An unexplained percentage is the only progress signal
observation: Profile's stat row reads "1 ROOMS / 1 SAVED / 63% MATCH" where the same device showed "48% MATCH" before sign-in, with nothing on screen saying what is matched or why it moved; the taste portrait carries an unlabelled progress bar at roughly 45% under "WHY PATINA SEES THIS".
why_it_matters: The app's only sense of "I am getting somewhere" is a number nobody can explain, which is a progress illusion rather than earned momentum.
already_ruled: C5 (no fabricated stats); U43 replaced the old "47% Style Confidence"
july_status: residual — same class as U43, on a different stat
proposal_seed: Say what the percentage matches, or replace it with a count of real things.
